name: com.ampdat/control
title: Ampdat Control
description: A title search for DeFi: deterministic control checks & audit trails (Morpho, Compound v3, Safes).

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: What this server can answer about: which contract families on which chain (today, on Ethereum mainnet: every Morpho vault, MetaMorpho v1.0 and v1.1 and Morpho Vaults V2; Compound v3's six lending markets and the governance they share; many of the Safes that hold roles on those contracts; and the contracts of six stablecoins, USDC, USDT, USDS, DAI, PYUSD and USD1), how many contracts, and the block the data is at. Call it once to learn the scope, or with `address` to check whether one address is covered before relying on an answer.

tools.name: search_covered_contracts
tools.description: Find a covered contract's address from words the user gave: its name (e.g. 'Steakhouse USDC'), its asset symbol (e.g. 'WETH') or part of its address. Returns up to `limit` matches with address, name, asset and family. Use it when the user names a vault, a lending market (e.g. 'Compound USDC') or a coin instead of giving an address, then call get_control_state with the address.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the contract's name, asset symbol, family or address. Case does not matter.

tools.name: get_control_state
tools.description: Who controls a covered contract right now: who holds each role and what that holder is (a single key, a Safe and its threshold, a DAO, a known contract); what each role can change and how much notice (timelock) each change gives; and the changes queued in the contracts it reads, when each can take effect and who can revoke it. A notice that is not known (notice_s null) does not mean there is none. For a Morpho vault, before a deposit or while holding: the owner, curator, guardian or sentinels, and allocators. For a Compound v3 market: its governance and the Timelock every change waits in, what is queued or under vote and who can cancel it, and who can pause the market. For a stablecoin: who can mint, burn, pause, freeze, upgrade the contract or appoint those roles. For a Safe: its signers' threshold, modules and guards, and the vault roles it holds (holds_roles_on); a Safe changes in one transaction, so nothing in it is pending. Deterministic facts from the chain at a stated block; a title search, not a rating, so it returns no safety score. An address that is not covered returns covered: false.

address.description: The contract's address on Ethereum mainnet (0x and 40 hex digits), e.g. a Morpho vault's, a Compound v3 market's, a Safe's or a stablecoin's. Not a name: use search_covered_contracts to find an address.

tools.name: get_control_evidence
tools.description: The machine-readable, evidence-backed answer for one covered contract (the subject/v1 envelope): the full control graph (each Safe's signers, threshold, modules and guard, EIP-7702 delegates, and what is still unresolved), the complete state (every market, cap and queue), every pending change as a record with the transaction and log it rests on, the 20 most recent changes, and the value at stake. Use it when the user needs to verify or audit, not just read: the whole chain behind a role holder in one answer, what a pending change rests on, or the exact caps. Paid per call over x402; a call without a payment returns the price and where to buy, and charges nothing. get_control_state is the free summary.

address.description: The contract's address on Ethereum mainnet (0x and 40 hex digits), e.g. a Morpho vault's, a Compound v3 market's, a Safe's or a stablecoin's. Not a name: use search_covered_contracts to find an address.

sections.description: Optional: only these parts of the envelope (default all). The whole answer can exceed 50 KB.

tools.name: get_change_records
tools.description: Past and recent changes as records, for monitoring a position or auditing a contract's history: the change history as record/v1 records, oldest first: what changed, from what to what, who acted, who may execute or revoke it, when it takes effect, and the transaction and log each rests on. With `address`, one contract's history; without, the feed across every covered contract (filter with `since`, a block number). Paged: pass the previous result's next_cursor. Paid per call over x402; a call without a payment returns the price and where to buy, and charges nothing.

observed_status.description: A record's status as first observed; a record never changes, so what is pending now is get_control_state's `pending`.

family.description: Feed only: a family id from get_coverage, e.g. metamorpho-v1.1.
